title: Asparagus Tartlets
description: Light, summery puff pastry tartlets topped with Gruyère cheese and chargrilled asparagus tips — a dinner-party staple.
steps: Defrost the pastry. Cook the asparagus tips in a griddle pan with seasoning and olive oil for about 8 minutes until tender and slightly charred. Reserve the pan liquid.
Roll out the defrosted pastry to about 0.5cm thick. Divide into 4 portions on fresh greaseproof paper on a baking sheet.
Score a smaller rectangle 1.5cm inside the edge of each tartlet (the border will puff up in the oven). Brush with the pan oil.
Grate the cheese and pile even portions in the inner rectangle of each tartlet. Arrange the asparagus on top.
Refrigerate for 10 minutes. Preheat the oven to 195°C/175°C fan.
Bake for 35 minutes until pastry is puffed and golden. Serve hot or cold.
notes: Makes 4 tartlets. Serve with a few green leaves on the side.
